name: Aotsuki Eito
source:
Zodiac Sign: Pisces
Likes: Cleaning
Dislikes: Loud Noises, Ugly Things
Specialist Skill: Special Fortunetelling

"And friends should help each other out, isn't that right? That's why I've decided to fight, too. I've found something that I want to protect."

Takumi's most trusted ally. Eito cares very deeply for his friends and isn't shy about expressing those feelings, corny as they may sound. He's been weak and sickly since he was little, but his impressive intellect might be just what the team needs to guide them through the war safely.

[From [url=https://hundred-line.com/en/character/?p=eito]official site[/url]+in-game profile]
